# Seeds whose SELF-HOST arm64 result disagrees with the interpreter's, for
# TestDifferential_SelfHostArm64 (internal/e2e/diff_oracle_selfhost_arm64_test.go).
#
# Format: <seed> <reason + issue>. Blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# Same contract as the x86-64 leg: a listed seed that starts PASSING fails
# too, because an allowlist nobody prunes is where bugs go to be forgotten.
# The range this covers is the default 0..511 window; a seed outside it that
# diverges in the nightly sweep is a new finding to triage, not a row to add.
